newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Star refinery shutdown RFCC to March 24.
newsitem.headline: Thai Star refinery shutdown RFCC to March 24.

text.p: Star Petroleum Refining Co has shut down a 37,000-barrel-per-day residual fluid catalytic cracker (RFCC) for two weeks to March 24, the company said on Wednesday.
"Star Petroleum has a RFCC that will be shut down for a period of about two weeks for maintenance. It is scheduled to start-up by March 24," the company said in reply to a Reuters quiry.
Industry sources said the RFCC has been having problems since early March had already been shut down twice.
The RFCC produces mainly gasoline and liquified petroleum gas.
Star Petroleum Refining is a 60:40 joint-venture between Caltex, a joint venture between U.S. majors Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc and state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT).
PTT sources said the company will not be importing gasoline for the time being as it has sufficient inventories.
